LDA $DC0D
LDA $DD0D

nodes.title: BOOT / TITLE
code:
Show the bitmap menu.
Play menu music.
Fire starts the game.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; BOOT / TITLE
; Show the bitmap menu. Play menu music. Fire starts the game.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X
;   $C008: lives

; BootTitle
; Display the bitmap menu; music runs only here. Fire begins the game.

BootTitle:
SEI
CLD
LDA #$36
; STA $0001 - keep original absolute encoding and timing.
.byte $8D,$01,$00
LDA #$00
LDX #$7F

ClearState:
STA $C000,X
DEX
BPL ClearState
LDA #$03
STA $C008
LDA #$00
STA $DC02
LDA #$FF
STA $DC00

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; BOOT / TITLE
; Show the bitmap menu. Play menu music. Fire starts the game.

; TitleLoop
; Continue the routine around the neighbouring Dev Machine macro.

TitleLoop:
JSR TitleFrame
LDA $DC00
AND #$10
BNE TitleLoop

TitleRelease:
JSR TitleFrame
LDA $DC00
AND #$10
BEQ TitleRelease
JMP SetupGame

TitleFrame:

nodes.title: RESPAWN
code:

Clear shots and enemies.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; RESPAWN
; Reset the player state. Clear shots and enemies. Start the next wave.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X
;   $C001: player Y
;   $C004: shot active flag
;   $C005: shot X
;   $C006: shot Y

; ResetActors
; Reset the player, projectiles and enemy state for a fresh life.

; A new life begins with a centred ship and no active projectile.
ResetActors:
LDA #$00
STA $C044
LDX #$03

; Clear every explosion timer so old effects cannot survive a respawn.
ClearExplosions:
STA $C040,X
DEX
BPL ClearExplosions
LDA #$90
STA $C000
LDA #$C8
STA $C001
LDA #$00
STA $C004
STA $C005
STA $C006
STA $C00A
STA $C00B
STA $C012
STA $C014
LDX #$03

; Clear the four enemy slots and restart their wave counters.
ClearWave:
STA $C028,X
STA $C024,X
DEX
BPL ClearWave
LDA #$30
STA $C013
LDA #$64
STA $C009
RTS

code:
Port 2 selects callbacks.
Diagonals combine moves.
Fire uses an edge latch.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE
; Port 2 selects callbacks. Diagonals combine moves. Fire uses an edge latch.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X
;   $C001: player Y
;   $C044: player explosion timer

; A bursting player cannot move or fire.
Input:
LDA $C044
BEQ InputAlive
RTS
InputAlive:
; Save the previous position for movement/collision work.
LDA $C000
STA $C010
LDA $C001
STA $C011

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE
; Port 2 selects callbacks. Diagonals combine moves. Fire uses an edge latch.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X
;   $C001: player Y
;   $C004: shot active flag
;   $C005: shot X
;   $C006: shot Y

; $F8 is the active-low joystick sample stored by the JOYSTICK macro.
; $C00B is an edge latch: hold fire without retriggering the sound.
LDA $F8
STA $C00C
; Fire is tested after movement, including diagonal movement.
LDA $F8
AND #$10
BNE FireReleased
LDA $C00B
BNE InputDone
LDA #$01
STA $C00B
LDA $C004
BNE InputDone
LDA #$01
STA $C004
LDA $C000
CLC
ADC #$00
STA $C005
LDA $C001
SEC
SBC #$08
STA $C006
JSR FireSound
RTS

; Clear the latch so the next press can fire again.
FireReleased:
LDA #$00
STA $C00B

; Return to the caller after processing the current input.
InputDone:
RTS

nodes.title: ATTACK WAVES
code:
Read WAVE_SCRIPT rows.
Choose path and spacing.
Advance active enemies.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ATTACK WAVES
; Read WAVE_SCRIPT rows. Choose path and spacing. Advance active enemies.
; State used here:
;   $C00D: animation clock
;   $C024: enemy Y array
;   $C028: enemy active flags
;   $C040: enemy explosion timers

; Enemy
; Read WAVE_SCRIPT records: path, start X, count and spawn spacing.

; Spawn from the wave table, then update each live enemy.
Enemy:
INC $C00D
JSR WaveSpawn
LDX #$00

; X selects one of the four enemy slots. Skip unused slots.
EnemyLoop:
LDA $C028,X
BNE EnemyActive
JMP EnemyNext

; Advance this enemy before selecting its horizontal path.
EnemyActive:
INC $C024,X
LDA $C024,X
CMP #$E8
BCC EnemyPath
LDA #$00
STA $C028,X
JMP EnemyNext

; The wave record selects straight, left, right, zigzag or sine motion.
EnemyPath:
INC $C02C,X
LDA $C034,X
BEQ EnemyStraight
CMP #$01
BEQ EnemyLeft
CMP #$02
BEQ EnemyRight
CMP #$03
BEQ EnemyZig
LDA $C02C,X
AND #$7F
TAY
LDA $B100,Y
CLC
ADC $C030,X
JMP EnemyStore

; Straight waves keep their current X position.
EnemyStraight:
LDA $C030,X
JMP EnemyStore

; Drift left while the common update moves the enemy down.
EnemyLeft:
LDA $C02C,X
LSR
STA $C019
LDA $C030,X
SEC
SBC $C019
JMP EnemyStore

; Drift right while the common update moves the enemy down.
EnemyRight:
LDA $C02C,X
LSR
CLC
ADC $C030,X
JMP EnemyStore

; Use the phase counter to reverse horizontal direction periodically.
EnemyZig:
LDA $C02C,X
AND #$3F
CMP #$20
BCC ZigAscending
EOR #$3F

ZigAscending:
ASL
SEC
SBC #$1F
CLC
ADC $C030,X

; Save the chosen X position back into this enemy slot.
EnemyStore:
STA $C020,X

; Advance X and repeat until all four slots have been considered.
EnemyNext:
INX
CPX #$04
BEQ EnemyDone
JMP EnemyLoop

EnemyDone:
RTS

; Count down the gap between spawns; return while the timer is active.
WaveSpawn:
LDA $C013
BEQ WaveReady
DEC $C013
RTS

; Each WAVE_SCRIPT record is four bytes: path, start X, count, interval.
; Multiply the record index by four to read the next row at $B000.
WaveReady:
LDA $C014
BNE WaveFindSlot
LDA $C012
STA $C007
ASL
ASL
TAY
LDA $B000,Y
STA $C016
LDA $B001,Y
STA $C017
LDA $B002,Y
STA $C014
LDA $B003,Y
STA $C018
INC $C012
LDA $C012
AND #$07
STA $C012

; Find a free hardware-enemy slot before spawning.
WaveFindSlot:
LDX #$00

; A slot is free only when both its enemy and explosion are inactive.
WaveSlot:
LDA $C028,X
ORA $C040,X
BEQ WaveCreate
INX
CPX #$04
BNE WaveSlot
RTS

; Copy the wave settings into the free slot and start it at Y=72.
; The sprite routine chooses the user-made fade frame during entry.
WaveCreate:
LDA $C017
STA $C020,X
STA $C030,X
LDA $C016
STA $C034,X
LDA #$48
STA $C024,X
LDA #$00
STA $C02C,X
LDA #$01
STA $C028,X
DEC $C014
BEQ WavePause
LDA $C018
STA $C013
RTS

; After the final enemy, leave a short pause before the next wave.
WavePause:
LDA #$60
STA $C013
; Return through the explicit RTS node directly below this code block.

nodes.title: PROJECTILE
code:
Move the shot upward.
Retire it off screen.
Hits are checked next.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; PROJECTILE
; Move the shot upward. Retire it off screen. Hits are checked next.
; State used here:
;   $C004: shot active flag
;   $C006: shot Y

; Shot
; Advance the player shot and retire it beyond the playfield.

Shot:
LDA $C004
BEQ ShotDone
LDA $C006
SEC
SBC #$04
STA $C006
CMP #$4E
BCS ShotDone
LDA #$00
STA $C004

ShotDone:
RTS

nodes.title: COLLISIONS / LIVES
code:
Test shots and enemies.
Update score and lives.
Start explosion effects.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; COLLISIONS / LIVES
; Test shots and enemies. Update score and lives. Start explosion effects.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X
;   $C001: player Y
;   $C004: shot active flag
;   $C005: shot X
;   $C006: shot Y

; Hits
; Resolve hits, score and lives; start the matching explosion effect.

; A hit changes game state and starts effects; drawing happens later.
Hits:
LDA $C044
BEQ HitsAlive
RTS

HitsAlive:
LDA $C009
BEQ HitsStart
DEC $C009

HitsStart:
LDX #$00

; Check each active enemy against the player and the single shot.
HitLoop:
LDA $C028,X
BNE HitActive
JMP HitNext

HitActive:
LDA $C009
BNE CheckShotHit
LDA $C000
SEC
SBC $C020,X
CLC
ADC #$0F
CMP #$1E
BCS CheckShotHit
LDA $C001
SEC
SBC $C024,X
CLC
ADC #$0D
CMP #$1A
BCS CheckShotHit
JSR Damage
RTS

; Only an active projectile can score a hit.
CheckShotHit:
LDA $C004
BEQ HitNext
LDA $C005
SEC
SBC $C020,X
CLC
ADC #$09
CMP #$12
BCS HitNext
LDA $C006
SEC
SBC $C024,X
CLC
ADC #$0C
CMP #$18
BCS HitNext
LDA #$00
STA $C004
STA $C028,X
LDA #$18
STA $C040,X
JSR ExplosionSound
INC $C00F

HitNext:
INX
CPX #$04
BEQ HitsDone
JMP HitLoop

HitsDone:
RTS

; Lose a life and start the player burst before allowing a respawn.
Damage:
LDA #$18
STA $C044
STA $C040,X
LDA #$00
STA $C028,X
STA $C004
JSR ExplosionSound
DEC $C008
BNE DamageDone
LDA #$03
STA $C008
LDA #$00
STA $C00F

DamageDone:
RTS

LSR

; FIXED HUD / RASTER
; IRQ selects HUD scroll. Next IRQ resumes world. Callbacks return via RTS.
; State used here:

;   $D016: VIC horizontal mode and fine scroll

; Raster callbacks keep the HUD steady while the playfield scrolls.

; Use fixed fine-scroll values for the top HUD.
HudFixed:
LDA #$18
STA $D011
LDA #$08
STA $D016
RTS

HudPlayfield:
; LDA $0063 - keep original absolute encoding and timing.
.byte $AD,$63,$00
ORA #$10
STA $D011
LDA #$18
STA $D016
RTS

; EXPLOSIONS / SFX
; Advance short explosions. Play effects on voice 3. Tick SFX once per frame.
; State used here:
;   $C040: enemy explosion timers

; Advance explosion animation and sound effects without restarting music.

Effects:
